# Docs state principles and rationale, not who said them
<!-- GENERATED from the Phrase Board (issue #154, sha256:d64ea2f03e2d0c32b9498a189ba0946f61af1c17eb31fb395dc6f7d226f91256). Do not edit this file: edit the issue. -->


- **Status:** Ready
- **Shape:** Story
- **Type:** docs (small card; a style rule applied once, then enforced)
- **Milestone:** Docs that stay useful: principles and rationale
- **Source:** Product-owner direction relayed 2026-10-28: the docs should explain what makes sense for the product and why, not who said it. The repository is public, so this also removes personal references. No Decider needed: it is a style rule for documents, not a product decision.
- **Depends on:** 153
- **Story:** As Morgan, I want every document to state a direction as a product principle with its rationale, so that I can understand and challenge it without knowing who proposed it.
- **Acceptance criteria (Given/When/Then; at most 3, each failing on partial work):**
  1. Given the tracked documents (VISION.md, the working agreement, ADRs, decision records, retros, experiments, MOB.md, DRIVERS.md, the verdict page and the board cards) and the mob-defaults templates, When the rewrite is done, Then no tracked document names the product owner or quotes the product owner verbatim: each direction reads as a principle with its rationale (for example: web concepts live in a web extension so the core stays domain-neutral and smaller to learn), facts and numbers and the Decider numbers stay, and where an escalation owner must be named (the safety carve-out, one-way doors, stop conditions) the role is the product owner
  2. Given PERSONAS.md, When it is read, Then the product owner is not a persona; personas are representative users; the stories that named him now name a representative persona (a new persona for a product owner of a team that ships AI-written code is added), and scripts/check-story-persona.py and its tests accept the new set
  3. Given the repository, When a check runs, Then it fails if a tracked file contains the product owner's personal name or a quotation attributed to him (a small allowlist of exactly the files that must name the check itself), so the rule holds from now on, and the same check is added to the mob-defaults template

## Context

- Docs and checks only; the frozen scored documentation (docs/GRAMMAR.md, docs/CHEATSHEET.md, orders.phrase) holds no such references and must not change (D72). Board cards are issue bodies: the archive under board/ is generated, so the text is changed in the issues with a reviewed script and the archive regenerated. Do not derail the prototype path.

## Task force

- Author [author]: next in the rotation | why: D15 rotation authorship
- Reviewer [reviewer]: a non-author seat | why: non-author review of the diff (D15)
- Facilitator: Claude | why: runs the checks and any real run after review; takeovers are logged

## Done when

```
python scripts/check-no-personal-names.py
dotnet test Phrase.sln --filter "Status!=Pending"
```
